_comment: English bodies for elizaos (framework). Mechanism per C0-1..6. No extraSections in source; sections/sectionTitles omitted. providers not rendered — not included.

axes.model_access: Plugin-style multi-model access (each vendor's API and local lines have plugins, not itemized); its core is not the model but the "character" abstraction — one agent configuration file defines persona + capabilities.
axes.runtime: A TypeScript runtime (official repo description: "Open source agentic operating system"): run a resident process, the agent connects to channels per its character config. GitHub elizaOS/eliza 19,739 stars, last push 2026-10-30 (API verified, active).
axes.local_files: Self-hosted, running in your own process/machine; memory and state live in a local storage layer (details not itemized).
axes.background: Resident process + multi-channel connection is the default form: the agent stays online long-term receiving messages and acting per its character — the "character agent" is the core of its product narrative.
axes.tools: The plugin ecosystem is the main axis (channel plugins / action plugins); MCP support status not itemized.
axes.context: The character file defines persona and knowledge surface, shared across channels (official docs: Character Interface / Agent Configuration on record).
axes.permissions: Plugins and actions can reach external accounts/channels — which channels to connect and which credentials to grant is the configurator's responsibility; third-party plugin code must be audited by you.
axes.fit: Fits: "a resident agent with a persona" (social/companion/community bots), the TS ecosystem, plugin-style extension. Does not fit: coding-task bases, enterprise workflow orchestration, scenarios sensitive to third-party plugin supply chains.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md).
unknowns:
- MCP support status (not itemized)
- Memory/state storage-layer details (not itemized)
- The governance relationship between Eliza Research, the elizaOS community, and the token ecosystem (not verified, no assertion made)
related: Same-category contrast: CrewAI orchestrates multi-agent work by "role division"; ElizaOS keeps a single agent resident by "role persona" — two meanings of "character".
Same-category contrast: both are resident general-purpose agent runtimes — Hermes follows the model-vendor line, ElizaOS the community-plugin line.
Cross-category contrast: ChatGPT's "custom GPTs" are also persona-style characters but run inside the official hosted surface; ElizaOS runs characters in your own process and channels.
